facts.fact: Mel 问他还剩几天——三天
房子修好了却仍睡 Max 家——想留下最后的夜晚
facts.anchor: I could have gone back to my house; it’s all fixed

facts.fact: EJ 的新红旗：和别的女人聊「儿子生病要钱」——Mel 怀疑全是谎言
facts.anchor: He was making out that he needed money because his son is sick.

facts.fact: 生日创伤：八岁那年被父亲禁足——父母从此再没办过生日
facts.anchor: I haven’t celebrated it since I was eight

facts.fact: 她回避生日——连续十五年
facts.anchor: My parents never threw me a party again, so now I avoid birthdays.

facts.fact: Mel 的梦想：帮别人策划婚礼——这才是她学摄影的原因
facts.anchor: It’s my dream to help others plan their weddings.

facts.fact: 危机：Bailey 因保护 Gina 被叫校长室——Els 出差，Max 一小时后才到
facts.anchor: Bailey’s been dragged into the headmaster’s office

facts.fact: 结尾：谁都不能碰 Bailey 和 Gina——她冲出教室
facts.anchor: No one messes with Bailey or Gina.
